hero.title: Built by riders, for bike lovers

story.title: Our story
story.p1: Bike lovers deserve a shop that understands them. From our showroom, we bring you bikes of every kind: from your first bike or your child's, to a trail-ready mountain bike, a fast road bike or the classic Rambo, alongside helmets, lights and accessories.
story.p2: We explain things plainly and stay with you after the sale. Whether you ride the desert trails, the city's streets or the open road, we want every ride to start with the right bike.
story.imageAlt: Banaweer showroom with bikes on display (placeholder)

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: To be the first choice for bike lovers in Saudi Arabia, and to help build an active, confident community of cyclists.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: To offer reliable bikes and kids' products at fair prices, with honest advice and service that keeps every rider on the road.

values.title: Values
values.text: Trust, quality, safety and a real passion for bikes, in everything we sell and every customer we serve.
